sentences: A constant-gap Max-Clique problem distinguishes graphs with a large clique from graphs whose cliques are smaller by a fixed factor.
The saved question asks whether this promise problem admits subexponential time in the vertex count under ETH.
The gap relaxes exact optimization while retaining a substantial difference between the two answer cases.
Resolving its compatibility with ETH would clarify the relationship between exact satisfiability hardness and approximation gaps.
The source excerpt does not specify the two thresholds or randomness convention, and its question is not itself an established ETH lower bound.
